description: This source file defines a 'Hooks' class used for setting up and tearing down test scenarios in a UI automation test suite for OrangeHRM. It contains methods that run before and after each test scenario, utilizing hooks provided by a testing framework. The class interacts with a driver factory to create and quit web drivers, and logs scenario status and errors.

classes.name: Hooks
classes.description: A class that manages setup and teardown actions around test scenarios, including driver management and logging.

methods.name: BeforeScenario
methods.description: Method annotated with [BeforeScenario], invoked before each test scenario to initialize the test environment, notably creating a web driver.

methods.name: AfterScenario
methods.description: Method annotated with [AfterScenario], invoked after each test scenario to perform cleanup, log scenario outcomes, and handle errors.
